arm_link_state._rule: Five DISTINCT machine values. They are never collapsed, and no downstream consumer may treat any of them as another.
arm_link_state.CONFIRMED: the results group is linked to exactly ONE registered armGroup by byte-exact label, by a case/whitespace-only label identity, or by an explicit within-record relation (arm description, interventionNames, a record-asserted bijection/partition/complement). Only this state may populate confirmed_registry_arm_label / confirmed_registry_arm_type.
arm_link_state.CONFIRMED_TYPE_ONLY: arm IDENTITY is not resolved, but every registered arm in the record carries a non-control type, so the arm TYPE is invariant over the candidate set. Populates candidate fields only.
arm_link_state.CANDIDATE: a proposed link supported by label strings alone (substring containment, a punctuation/spacing/dose-token variant, or a leaf recovery whose recovered label does not bind to a single registered arm). PROPOSED, NEVER CONFIRMED.
arm_link_state.CONTESTED: reserved value in this enumeration; contestation is carried on control_status and contested_flag (see below), because it is a property of the control claim, not of the link.
arm_link_state.UNRESOLVED: registered arms exist and are described, but the record does not distinguish them from one another for this group.
arm_link_state.UNKNOWN_IN_THIS_CACHE: no arm groups registered in this cache, or no label relation of any kind in this cache.

control_status._rule: UNKNOWN_IN_THIS_CACHE is NEVER read as NOT_CONTROL. CONTESTED is NEVER counted as a comparator. A *_CANDIDATE_* value is NEVER counted as a control.
control_status.CONTROL_PLACEBO_CONFIRMED: CONFIRMED link to an arm typed PLACEBO_COMPARATOR or SHAM_COMPARATOR.
control_status.CONTROL_NO_INTERVENTION_CONFIRMED: CONFIRMED link to an arm typed NO_INTERVENTION.
control_status.CONTROL_ACTIVE_COMPARATOR_CONFIRMED: CONFIRMED link to an arm typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR. A treated comparator, NOT an untreated or placebo control.
control_status.CONTROL_PLACEBO_CANDIDATE_GROUP_TEXT_ONL: the group's own record states placebo/sham; no confirmed registry link. Proposed only.
control_status.CONTROL_UNSPECIFIED_CANDIDATE_GROUP_TEXT: the group record says control/comparator without naming placebo; no confirmed registry link.
control_status.NOT_CONTROL_CONFIRMED: CONFIRMED link to an arm typed EXPERIMENTAL or OTHER, with no contradicting control language in the group record.
control_status.NOT_CONTROL_BY_ARM_SET_TYPE_INVARIANT: arm identity unresolved, but every registered arm in the record is typed EXPERIMENTAL/OTHER, so no assignment could make this group a control. Carries the stated assumption that the results group corresponds to some registered arm.
control_status.CONTESTED: the group's own record states placebo or no-intervention while the CONFIRMED registry arm is typed EXPERIMENTAL or OTHER. Neither field wins. NOT counted as a comparator and NOT counted as NOT_CONTROL.
control_status.UNKNOWN_IN_THIS_CACHE: control status is not determinable from this cache. Includes all 6 zero-registered-arm rows.

disposition_vs_job3._rule: The change map compares SEMANTIC CLASSES ONLY (CONTROL_SUPPORTED / CONTROL_PROPOSED / NOT_CONTROL / CONTESTED / UNKNOWN). The four-class collapse exists for the change map and is never written back onto a row; each row keeps its full machine value.

permitted_for_a_CONFIRMED_label_link: whitespace (including whitespace runs and whitespace around punctuation)
normalisation_policy.worked_refusal: '3.2 mg/kg' and '3.2 kg/mg' are a dose and a unit, not a formatting variant, and are never merged on string similarity. A link across a suspected typo requires independent within-record identity evidence; where identity is not established, the alternatives and the ambiguity are retained.
normalisation_policy.no_split_rule: Known-identical groups are not split, and different doses are not merged, merely to satisfy a scalar count.
